description.value: Runs the requested task at a duration interval such as 1h for the lifetime of the Factory Session.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: Request to execute at each interval.

parameters.name: every
parameters.description: Positive duration interval from 1s through 168h, such as 30s, 5m, 1h, or 1h30m.

parameters.name: triggerAtStart
parameters.description: Run once immediately after the controller Work is admitted.

parameters.name: maxConsecutiveFailures
parameters.description: Stop scheduling after this many consecutive failed executions; zero continues indefinitely.

parameters.name: executorProvider
parameters.description: Model provider for each scheduled execution; omitted values use operator defaults.

parameters.name: executorModel
parameters.description: Model for each scheduled execution; omitted values use operator defaults.
